partition_unmounted_automatic_mounting_s: Partition unmounted. Automatic mounting settings were preserved.
partition_mounted_at_the_configured_path: Partition mounted at the configured path.
choose_a_storage_partition_one_name_sets: Choose a storage partition. One name sets the filesystem label, GPT partition name and folder under /mnt.
demo_the_drives_below_are_examples_no_st: Demo: the drives below are examples. No storage is changed in the preview.
data_mounts_under_mnt_the_x_removes_only: Data mounts under /mnt. The X removes only that line's configuration; it does not eject the drive or delete its files.
use_up_to_16_characters_and_start_the_na: Use up to 16 characters and start the name with a letter or number. Allowed: unaccented letters, numbers, dots, hyphens and underscores.
use_in_more_than_one_linux_system: Use in more than one Linux system
this_storage_is_already_open_to_other_li: This storage is already open to other Linux systems: any account can write to it.
so_another_linux_installed_on_this_compu: So another Linux installed on this computer can write here too. On save, every current file and folder becomes changeable by any account on any system, and new ones too. Nothing is deleted; large drives may take a few minutes.
